plugins.name: scan-modules
plugins.description: Scan and cache project module structure for fast Claude context loading. Use /scan-modules:scan-modules to index your codebase, then Claude auto-loads the cache each session. Supports incremental updates via git diff and auto-update via post-commit hook. Works with Swift, TypeScript, Python, Go, and Rust.
